# SNNTRAINV19_z_TRAINDES_V19

DES-SN5YR's nominal SuperNNova model, copied from SNANA's
`$SNDATA_ROOT/models/classifiers/DES-SN5YR/SNNTRAINV19_z_TRAINDES_V19/`
(`model.pt`, with the `cli_args.json` and `data_norm.json` a prediction reads
beside it). Trained by Pippin on light curves whose bands are named `g`, `i`,
`r`, `z`, with the dataset step's `--redshift_label REDSHIFT_FINAL`
(`job.slurm` in the source directory).
